hero.description: Cobar, NSW - View from Fort Bourke Hill, over former site of Dapville & Wrightville (Aug 2024). The headframe of the Chesney mine is visible on the left, and the view is looking toward the New Occidental mine. The tailings heaps of the mine are visible in the distance, behind the Chesney headframe. Wrightville and Dapville were former mining villages that are now uninhabited parts of Cobar.
